active_goal_objective: Diagnose and generically repair the bounded prompt architecture and test controller, then continue through frozen candidate revisions until the same final architecture completes two consecutive full three-configuration matrices with fresh test-taker tasks and zero subject failures, zero missing cells, and valid durable terminals.
course_correction: The loop-buster detected churn but did not stop numbered-candidate meta-churn. This addendum makes stabilization an obligatory noncandidate phase before any further formal candidate, audit, freeze, canary, or subject call.

stabilization_lane.repair_policy: Fix findings inside create-only stabilization iterations and rerun the complete exit gate. Do not mint a candidate per finding.

minimum_trustworthy_experiment_boundary: trusted outer controller pinned to a pushed Git commit
exact frozen semantic inputs, schedule, routes, scorers, and byte manifest
exact rendered provider-input bytes recorded before dispatch
complete raw result and terminal process metadata captured before scoring
zero retries, replacements, best-of, thread reuse, or post-admission mutation
complete reopenable run accounting and terminal
explicit_nonblocking_residual_risks: recursive proof that the verifier cannot lie
required_simplification: remove callbacks that can expose controller internals
retain only executable surfaces used by the experiment

must_cover: yielded live sessions with multiple polls
deterministic_simulator.historical_requirement: Every normalized v8-v20 signature must fail on its predecessor evidence and pass in the simplified stabilization controller.

stabilization_exit_gate: every normalized v8-v20 regression signature PASS
no recursive authority, callback, capability, token, or unused helper surface
one holistic independent design review with zero experiment-validity blockers
safe Git commit and push with local HEAD equal to fetched origin/main
post_exit_sequence: mint exactly one new formal candidate from stabilized bytes
only a valid canary permits counted matrix 1
only a complete clean matrix 1 permits unchanged matrix 2
same_defect_rule: If the same normalized defect recurs inside stabilization, replace or delete the responsible component instead of adding another layer, then rerun the full simulator.
git_durability: At each completed stabilization gate, freeze, canary terminal, or matrix terminal, commit only owned completed artifacts, push origin/main, and verify local HEAD equals fetched origin/main. Never commit in-flight evidence.
nonclaims: This addendum does not weaken semantic acceptance, reuse subject evidence, or grant empirical credit to deterministic simulation.
This addendum does not authorize edits to Plans, ledger, Concepts, governance, or production code.
